## Description

A chat widget on the clinic's public profile. The tenant is resolved from a public widget key plus an origin allow-list; anonymous visitors get answers from the clinic's knowledge and can request an appointment or leave a message, which lands in the clinic inbox. No patient record is ever read on this channel.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A widget key used from an origin not on the list is refused; requests are rate-limited per key and per IP.
- [ ] **AC2.** The chat never reads or reveals patient records (no patient tools on this channel).
- [ ] **AC3.** Keyboard, screen reader and right-to-left work; axe clean in English and Arabic.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
